_comment: Written into ~/.codex/config.toml through Codex's own config API (codex app-server config/batchWrite). Projects under dev_root are marked trusted by `dev install`. `profiles` become ~/.codex/<name>.config.toml (`codex --profile deep`); Agent roles come from config/crew.json (dev crew). The main model and effort stay the user's choice (/model): devkit never sets them. review_model makes /review use the strongest model, and project_doc_max_bytes reads a project's AGENTS.md whole (Codex's default stops at 32 KiB; Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md whole).
